source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U19: Identify consumer standing, service deficiency and complaint grounds

payload.title: Start with the person, transaction and alleged failure
payload.core_explanation_md:
A consumer complaint needs the relevant complainant standing and transaction. Consideration can be paid, promised or deferred, and the definition includes the described approved users or beneficiaries. Banking is among the service categories, but commercial-purpose and other exclusions need the actual facts. The goods/self-employment explanation must not be treated as an unlimited exception for every commercial banking service.

Defect concerns the relevant goods or product standard; deficiency concerns the quality, nature or performance of a service, including the described negligence or withholding of relevant information. A written allegation, its denial and a proved breach are separate stages. Identify the contracted obligation, conduct and evidence instead of equating dissatisfaction with automatic liability.

self_check.prompt_text: Is every disappointed banking customer automatically a successful complainant?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Standing, scope, obligation and the alleged deficiency need evidence.

payload.stem_md: A complaint alleges that a paid banking service was not performed as undertaken. Which assessment is needed first?

options.text_md: Only the amount the complainant wishes to receive
options.explanation_md: A requested remedy does not establish standing or breach.

options.text_md: Consumer standing, service scope and evidence of the alleged deficiency
options.explanation_md: The legal relationship and failure must be established.

options.text_md: A rule that banking can never be a service
A presumption that every denial proves the bank case
options.explanation_md: A denial creates a dispute rather than proving either side.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal relationship and failure must be established.

payload.stem_md: An analyst extends the goods/self-employment explanation to every commercial service without checking wording. What is the defect?

options.text_md: All commercial transactions are necessarily identical
options.explanation_md: The statutory categories and explanations differ.

options.text_md: Consideration is irrelevant in every case
options.explanation_md: It is material to the consumer/service framework.
The definition includes the specified approved beneficiaries.

options.text_md: The exception is being enlarged beyond its stated scope
options.explanation_md: Apply the relevant clause to the actual transaction.
